items.title: MST3K Shorts: X Marks The Spot
items.description: Poor Joe gets grilled in a heavenly court in this WWII era film promoting road safety in New Jersery.

items.title: MST3K Shorts: Alphabet Antics
items.description: A charming rhyme for children that teaches them the alphabet, including many now politically-incorrect things, dangerous sequences, and some plagiarism.

items.title: MST3K Shorts: Speech: Using Your Voice
items.description: Educational short on public speaking teaching the importance of being heard, being understood, and being "pleasing".

items.title: MST3K Shorts: Aquatic Wizards
items.description: As much fun as anybody could hope to have watching waterskiing.

items.title: MST3K Shorts: Catching Trouble
items.description: Ross, an overly enthusiastic wildlife trapper torments snakes, wildcats and bear cubs to send off to the zoo.

items.title: MST3K Shorts: The Home Economics Story
items.description: Kay learns of value of a Home Economics degree in all aspects of a woman's life.

items.title: MST3K Shorts: Mr. B Natural
items.description: A sexually androgynous spirit of music teaches a young nerdish boy the benefit of a musical education and the right instruments.

items.title: MST3K Shorts: Posture Pals
items.description: School competition to see who has the best posture, and the lengths and tricks four kids go through to win those paper crowns.

items.title: MST3K Shorts: Appreciating Our Parents
items.description: A young boy learns how effective guilt can be when he starts to help out his family about the house.

items.title: MST3K Shorts: Johnny At The Fair
items.description: A young boy ditches his parents at the Canadian National Exhibition and sets off for adventure, meeting some celebrities along the way.

items.title: MST3K Shorts: Circus On Ice
items.description: This short features women in striped suits on leashes, simluated gunshots and lots of the color pink!

items.title: MST3K Shorts: Here Comes The Circus
items.description: Watch and enjoy a wide variety of circus acts - if you dare! The short is a look at the Clyde Beatty circus, featuring legendary clown Emmett Kelly.

items.title: MST3K Shorts: What To Do On A Date
items.description: Nick wants to take Kay out on a date, but isn't sure what they'd do. The short offers ideas like taffy pulls and scavenger sales. Nothing says romantic quite like a scavenger sale. Ultimately, all the kids have a wholesomely-celibate-vanilla-white-Eisenhower’s-America good time.

items.title: MST3K Shorts: The Truck Farmer
items.description: Nick wants to take Kay out on a date, but isn't sure what they'd do. The short offers ideas like taffy pulls and scavenger sales. Nothing says romantic quite like a scavenger sale. Ultimately, all the kids have a wholesomely-celibate-vanilla-white-Eisenhower’s-America good time.

items.title: MST3K Shorts: Body Care And Grooming
items.description: A short aimed at older teens/college students explaining why bathing and good personal hygiene are things to consider.

items.title: MST3K Shorts: Is This Love?
items.description: A girl goes against the old-fashioned love of her parents (and very old-looking roommate), abandons her parents, and runs away with a new hookup. The short ends asking whether their love will last long or not. (It won't.)

items.title: MST3K Shorts: Cheating
items.description: A young boy learns an important lesson about cheating.

items.title: MST3K Shorts: What About Juvenile Delinquency?
items.description: A band of no-good punks beat a guy for driving too slow and steal his mechanical pencil, before arriving to pick up their missing member Jamie, the son of the man they've just beaten.

items.title: MST3K Shorts: Last Clear Chance
items.description: Friendly Patrolman Hal Jackson (Boyett) visits the Dixon family to instruct their youngest son, Alan (Bosworth), in the art of safe and courteous driving. He relates many grisly tales of various young drivers, his main advice being to pay attention, but Alan's older brother Frank Jr. (Bill Agee) isn't listening, and drives with his girlfriend Betty (Lynch) into the path of an oncoming train while turning around and waving at the car behind him.

items.title: MST3K Shorts: Design For Dreaming
items.description: In this musical short, a woman dreams of a mysterious masked man who takes her to see the future... as represented by the 1956 General Motors Motorama.

items.title: MST3K Shorts: Uncle Jim's Dairy Farm
items.description: Two siblings from the city visit their uncle's dairy farm for the summer. The children tour the farm's modern facilities, including milking machines. During a summer of hard work and healthy living, the boy gains enough strength to finally climb a rope. At the end of the summer, the city-dwellers return to the metropolis with their family, wiser and healthier for having spent their summer on their uncle's farm.

items.title: MST3K Shorts: A Day At The Fair
items.description: A farming family prepares for their yearly trip to the Indiana State Fair, both to show off their wares and suckle from the teat of the 3-H Club.

items.title: MST3K Shorts: Why Study Industrial Arts?
items.description: Joe and the Coach double-team to explain to a high-school student disparaging shop class the many and varied uses for Industrial Arts in all aspects of modern life.

items.title: MST3K Shorts: Young Man's Fancy
items.description: A story sponsored by the Edison Electric Institute that encourages use of a number of home appliances. Teenage Judy is less than excited about her brother’s visit from college until she sees that her brother is accompanied by his roommate, Alexander Phipps. Judy is attracted to Alex (he makes her feel “squishy!”), but Alex seems only interested in engineering and time study. So Judy prepares dinner all by herself, using modern household appliances and electricity to impress him.

items.title: MST3K Shorts: Are You Ready For Marriage?
items.description: A high school senior named Sue and her boyfriend want to get married right after Sue graduates. A marriage counselor discourages the young couple from entering into a hasty marriage.

items.title: MST3K Shorts: Speech: Platform Posture and Appearance
items.description: Through liberal use of the knee test, looking good and standing tall, the secrets of public speaking are revealed.

items.title: MST3K Shorts: Money Talks!
items.description: Having trouble saving money, a kid gets advice from Ben Franklin himself.

items.title: MST3K Shorts: Progress Island U.S.A.
items.description: Modern Puerto Rico has a lot to offer.

items.title: MST3K Shorts: Once Upon A Honeymoon
items.description: A songwriter's wife, frustrated about not having sex with her husband for a year after marriage, fantasizes about new home decor with matching colored phones, with the help of a fey bespectacled angel.

items.title: MST3K Shorts: The Chicken of Tomorrow
items.description: We learn what is being done 'today' to create the Chicken of Tomorrow (complete with the growth process of the chicken), with a side mention of how important gas stations and oil are to the poultry industry.

items.title: MST3K Shorts: A Case of Spring Fever
items.description: An animated pixie named Coily grants a man his wish that all springs disappear...a wish that he soon regrets.

items.title: Hired! (Part 2)
